'''Merrck Nall''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who was the father of [[Gradress Nall]]. During his career Nall wielded a [[DAS-430 Neural Inhibitor/Legends|Neural Inhibitor]], and he popularized the use of such weapons among [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]].
